title: itsmejagz
subtitle: Personal Branding & Visual Identity
description: A full visual identity system built for JAGZ — an IRL streamer from New Zealand making his presence known on the streets and on screen.

sections.label: Overview
paragraphs: JAGZ is an IRL streamer from New Zealand — taking to the streets and building a community one stream at a time. This visual identity was built to match that energy and give him a look that stands out. Starting from the original JAGZ logo, the identity was expanded into a full system — refining the colour palette, establishing logo variations, and building out a consistent set of visual rules that flex across streaming and social.

Neon-shifted red and crisp white cut through deep navy, capturing the feel of city lights after dark. Bold, electric, and built to last. The result is a visual language that puts JAGZ on the map — loud enough to stop the scroll, considered enough to grow with him.

sections.label: Logo System
paragraphs: The main logo was the starting point — with additional style variations built out to give flexibility across different contexts and formats.

sections.label: Social Assets
paragraphs: The identity extended across all of JAGZ's social platforms — YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Kick. Each asset was designed to be immediately recognisable while staying consistent across different formats and contexts.

sections.label: Stream Panels
paragraphs: Stream panels and overlay screens were designed to bring the identity into the live streaming environment — offline screens, donation banners, and social follow panels.
